items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: How much did you get paid, say, with Clyde Carr's band? ... The night dance was down a quarter.

ctx.x: This fellow, he's broke up out here to play a rubber show, Ransom. He's a wonderful bass player. Yeah, that Ransom. Yeah, I knew him.
How much did you get paid, say, with Clyde Carr's band? Practically nothing?

You know, I think it's something people ought to know about the Depression. Well, for the matinee, you got, I think the matinee at that time was paying six bits, sometime a dollar. The night dance was down a quarter. Unless there didn't be a special dance, some club or another, well then you could squeeze out maybe a down half, maybe two dollars.
